title: Cliff Wong on faking an orb with a drone-towed balloon

tellings.quote:
I talked to, uh, this guy Cliff Wong,

and I said, "If you wanted to fake X, Y,

told me,

plain: A drone expert named Cliff Wong is said to have explained how to fake an "orb", a glowing ball of light in the sky: tow a balloon behind a drone. A former intelligence official named Eric Haseltine tells this on the show. He says he asked Wong, whom he calls "the world's expert on drones," "If you wanted to fake X, Y, or Z, how would you do it?" and this is what Wong told him, which would mean some orb sightings could be staged.
